parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=8: val_bpb improved from 1.002556 to 0.987592. Increased capacity via depth scaling seems to yield significant gains despite potential step count reduction. Next: increasing DEPTH to 10 to follow the team trend of scaling depth for better capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 10 to further increase model capacity, following the successful trend of depth scaling observed in recent runs.
